svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Make two. Cut 892 mm of 45 x 70 mm timber; square the ends.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Heights below are from the bottom end. Drill across the 45 mm way,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: square to the face, on the centre line of the 70 mm face:

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: brace bolt 10.5 mm at 313; lock stud 10.5 mm at 593;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: axle 20.5 mm at 743; plate bolt 10.5 mm at 823;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Foot bracket bolt: 8.5 mm through the 70 mm way, 28 mm up.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The axle hole sets the focus height: drill it from both faces

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: with a long bit after a 6 mm pilot, so it stays square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Fit: stands on the middle of a side rail; the axle plate goes on

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the inner face, the logger box on the outer face of one upright.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: the axle holes of both uprights are at the same height.
